name: Portfolio AI Assistant
summary: A bilingual AI assistant that answers focused questions about my experience, projects, technologies, and education using a controlled public context.
functions: Provides suggested questions, maintains a short conversation, responds in English or Spanish, and falls back to safe local answers when the AI service is unavailable.
problem: Visitors can scan the portfolio, but finding a specific project, skill, or experience quickly still requires navigating several sections.
solution: I designed a compact assistant backed by a Python API and Workers AI, with a curated JSON knowledge source, strict scope rules, and no autonomous learning from visitors.

demo.title: Live AI assistant
demo.description: The assistant is available from the chat button in this portfolio and responds through a Python Worker connected to Workers AI.
